🇬🇧 A package of Immigration Rules changes came into force on 3 August, covering the Graduate route, family migration, immigration bail and ETAs.

The biggest change is a merged asylum interview, letting the Home Office decide weaker claims in one sitting. Credit where due, that is the right idea.

But it is procedure, not a border policy.
